mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (tenant_id, house_id, rating, content, like_count, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{houseId}, #{rating}, #{content}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM review WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND house_id = #{houseId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE house_id = #{houseId}
SELECT COUNT(rating) FROM review WHERE house_id = #{houseId}
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0), 1) FROM review WHERE house_id = #{houseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
